item.title: Cyprus borrowers abandon variable rates in shift to fixed-term loans
item.description: Cyprus borrowers have abandoned variable interest rates in a three-year reversal, with fixed-rate business loans surging from 1% to 35% of the market and fixed-rate housing loans now accounting for 64%, Central Bank data shows.
